subject: cult-info-f
title: CULT.INFO.F.----PR.TRS.
description: Diagram opening R(AS)CM(I)-24. The prose immediately above identifies the structural target: 'find a way to align this phenomenon with the factors that control the vibrational lining of American culture (and in this context, big business cannot make money).' The crossing diagrams how culture-information-focus structurally meets primary-transition at the corporate-recording-of-creative-music scale: CULT-INFO-F (culture information focus) crossed with PR-TRS (primary transition). CULT-INFO-F sits on the left with the subject-arrow; RT-ALGN (reality alignment) rises above-left and (P)RE-ST (the physical-universe redefinition of restructuralism) sits at top-center with APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions) anchoring the upper-right. PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) sits centrally as the bridging hub; PR-TRS is partner-axis at right with TR (transformation) hanging below. (R)PART (the reality of participation) anchors the lower-left as subject-side output; POL-DY (political dynamics), ALT-DEF (alternative definition), and STF (source transfer) cluster at the bottom-center to bottom-right as the bridging-side downward chain. Structural argument: when culture-information-focus is crossed with primary-transition, the upper diagonal RT-ALGN → RE-ST → APP-RDEF is the *corporate restructuralism route* — reality-alignment routes through restructuralism into applied-redefinitions on the partner-side. This is what big-business-recording does when it takes a form's cultural-information and converts it to primary-transition through the redefinition chain. PROG-CONT → PR-TRS → TR is the partner-axis's downward chain: progressional-continuance routes through primary-transition into transformation. The subject's PART → POL-DY → ALT-DEF → STF lower chain is what culture-information-focus produces *without* the partner-axis carrying it — participation routes through political-dynamics into alternative-definition and source-transfer on the form's own working axis. The big-business-cannot-make-money condition the prose names is structural: the upper diagonal route works for big business only when CULT-INFO-F can be routed through APP-RDEF, but creative-music's PART → POL-DY chain on the lower side would have to be allowed to feed back into PROG-CONT to make alternative-definition profitable, and the corporate route structurally refuses that feedback.
